name: wake
description: Generate a recent-context index plus stable truth and active handoffs for the given project, or the active project when project_name is omitted. Returns the wake-up text in `output` so the agent can ingest it directly, plus a structured bounded distill maintenance offer when Agent work is eligible.

project_name.description: Project name (defaults to active project when omitted)

no_auto_ingest.description: Skip the auto-ingest pass before generating wake-up text.

include_skill_hints.description: Opt-in compact skill hints appended to wake output.

skill_hint_limit.description: Maximum compact skill hints to append when include_skill_hints is enabled.

current_task.description: Optional current task used to build a task-aware wake packet.

deep_recall.description: Include cold/archive memory in task-aware wake planning.

include_provisional.description: Include provisional auto-promoted truth in task-aware wake planning.
